name: appsec-workflow
description: Run an agent-led security review with static taint analysis and create reusable vulnerability checks

interface.shortDescription: Create reusable vulnerability checks with static taint analysis
interface.longDescription: Use an AI agent to review the application. The agent adds project-specific taint rules and dependency models. OpenTaint runs whole-program static taint analysis. The workflow classifies the findings and can run proof-of-concept tests to confirm vulnerabilities. Reuse the rules and models in later scans.
defaultPrompt: Use the appsec-agent skill to run a deep scan with static triage
Use the appsec-agent skill to run a normal scan with static triage
Use the appsec-agent skill to run a lite scan with dynamic confirmation
